data.name: Asis
data.gender_notes: Asis is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Asis is the name of the god who personifies calmness, serenity, and peace. He is often depicted as a peaceful deity, seated in meditation or holding a lotus flower. Asis is also believed to be a guardian of the Earth and a supporter of all life. The name Asis carries the meaning “God of calmness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asis usually hope their child will grow to embody god of calmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes tranquility and calmness in the midst of chaos.
data.etymology: Asis belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of calmness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asis total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asis is associated with calmness, serenity, and peace in Hindu culture. It is a reminder of the importance of inner tranquility and harmony in the midst of the chaos and stress of daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Asis represents the divine principle of peace and calmness within. By invoking this name, one can call upon inner peace and calmness, helping to reduce anxiety, stress, and conflict within oneself and with others. It is also believed that worshiping or meditating on the deity Asis can bring about a deep sense of inner peace and spiritual growth.
